description: Deterministic rules for rejecting AI-generated text markers and enforcing human writing quality.

banned_constructions.name: negative_parallelism
banned_constructions.reason: Avoid negative parallelism ('not just X, but Y' or 'not only ... but also'); state the positive point directly.

banned_constructions.name: copula_avoidance
banned_constructions.reason: Avoid copula avoidance ('serves as', 'stands as', 'boasts'); use direct verbs.

banned_constructions.name: filler_openers
banned_constructions.reason: Avoid canned filler openers; start immediately with the substantive observation.

rule_of_three.description: Flags sentences built on three parallel items when the pattern repeats within a single piece.
